_about: Known accessibility violations the check tolerates. Each entry needs: path (page path such as /about/ or /es/about/, or * for any page), rule (axe rule id), selector or html (part of axe's target or of the element's HTML; blanket entries are rejected), reason, added (YYYY-MM-DD) and review_by (YYYY-MM-DD). An expired or unmatched entry fails the check. Only the owner approves new entries.
